INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Operating Systems and Utilities, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating Systems and Utilities.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating Systems and Utilities.

2. When learning Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

3. When learning Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.

4. When learning Presentation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Presentation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Presentation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Presentation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.

5. When learning Application Areas of ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Application Areas of ICT.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Application Areas of ICT.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Application Areas of ICT.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

7. When learning Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

8. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. Input Cable Tester
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

11. When learning Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

12. When learning Desktop Publishing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Desktop Publishing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Desktop Publishing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Desktop Publishing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain The Internet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

1. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating Systems and Utilities.

2. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating systems 1.4 Digital Citizenship 2.0 Productivity Tools 2.1 Word Proces.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Presentation.

5. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Application Areas of ICT.

6. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Word Processing 2.2 Presentation 2.3 Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Tec.

8. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

9. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. A — Information and Communication Technology

11. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing 3.0 Internet and Web Technologies 3.1 The Internet 3.2 Digita.

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Desktop Publishing.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet 3.2 Digital Communication Page 15 of 41 1 STRAND 1.0: ICT AND SOCIE; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of The Internet; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT 1.2 Application areas of ICT 1.3 Operating systems 1.4 Digit; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Introduction to ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
